description: This file defines the QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM Admin module. It extends a base FilterParams class and sets a default sort field for education qualification search filters.

classes.name: QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for handling search filter parameters related to education qualifications in the OrangeHRM system, including allowed sorting fields and default sort configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object, setting the default sort field to 'e.name'.
